1.d4 f5 2.g3 Nf6 3.Bg2 g6 4.Nf3 Bg7 5.O-.strategy: Stakes a claim to the d5 square and to space on the queenside, so Black cannot settle the centre with ...d5 as easily. The play divides: White's pressure on the queenside against Black's attack on the kingside.
The standard follow-up: the pawn controls e5, frees the c8 bishop and prepares the central break ...e5 that gives the g7 bishop its target. Black builds slowly, aiming for kingside play.
